bug.title: OpenAI Responses core compatibility is not independently closed
bug.summary: GitHub issue 56 is too broad to close as one provider claim. v0.8.3 only commits to Responses text, two-turn continuity, and function tools, split by protocol and provider fixture.

basis: v0.8.3 core scope limits Responses to text, two-turn, and function tools

steps: Run fixed local protocol mocks separately for Responses text, two-turn state continuity, and function call/result.
Record provider adapter and model mapping independently from protocol conformance.
Do not use image, proprietary reasoning, native streaming, or structured-output results to pass or fail this core gate.
reproduction.observed: Issue 56 remains open, but no current-target failure has yet been attributed to one of the three bounded Responses core rows.

confirmed_facts.statement: GitHub issue 56 remains open and the approved v0.8.3 plan limits its blocking scope to three Responses core behaviors.

hypotheses.statement: One or more bounded Responses rows may already pass on the current target and should not trigger a product edit.
